title: Apply the staging account deploy stack so the staging smoke test can pass
description:
Status 2026-10-19. Control plane, thin turn, auth and web are deployed from main to staging and production (production all green; see the handoff report). The staging smoke test job fails because the staging integration test role does not exist yet.

## What is merged
- develop (6b3db9e) has the staging-only integration test role in the staging account deploy stack (role chatticus-github-actions-integration-test-staging). Production has none, by design.
- The same stack apply also brings in the least-privilege staging deploy role merged on 2026-10-16, which replaces AdministratorAccess with only the calls the deploy workflows make. It was never applied to the live staging stack.

## What is NOT done (needs Ryan's Mac, AWS profile chatticus-production, folder /Users/home/Projects/Chattic.us)
1. git pull develop; run `cdk diff` for ChatticusAccountDeployStaging (read-only) and confirm only the test role and the least-privilege deploy role change.
2. Apply: `cd infra && eval "$(AWS_PROFILE=chatticus-production aws configure export-credentials --format env)" && sh deploy-chatticus-account-deploy.sh staging`. Never touch the production deploy stack.
3. Read stack output IntegrationTestRoleArn and set it: `gh variable set CHATTICUS_INTEGRATION_TEST_ALLOWED_ROLE_ARN --env staging --repo AnthusAI/Chatticus --body <arn>`.
4. Dispatch `Deploy ThinTurn (staging)` on main; confirm its smoke test job passes. If a staging deploy fails on permissions after the role change, fix the deploy role policy and redeploy.
5. Curl https://develop.chattic.us/, https://staging.chattic.us/ and https://chattic.us/ (cloud threads cannot reach them) and record the HTTP statuses.

## Blocker
The Remote Control session on the Mac refuses to run aws, cdk and gh apply commands (its safety checker, not a missing login; Ryan's AWS login works). Fix: allow aws, cdk, gh, curl and the deploy script in that session's permissions, or run the step 2 command once in a terminal.

## Done when
Smoke test green on staging, and the full rollout rule is met: all four components verified on development, staging and production with run links.

Set staging env variable CHATTICUS_INTEGRATION_TEST_ALLOWED_ROLE_ARN. Proven with the narrowed role from main (all success, no permission had to be added): verify-account-deploy-role staging run 39288552303; deploy-thinturn-staging 39289499432 (smoke-test pass); deploy-controlplane-staging 39291276627 (smoke-test pass); deploy-auth-staging 39292048380; deploy-web-staging 39293023049 (smoke-test pass); build-computer-image-release 39295649098 (push-staging and push-production pass); promote-computer-image-staging 39296084135 (commit 0b700c91). curl https://staging.chattic.us/ and /api/health both 200.
